verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents a JMAP API with session discovery, token auth and the IETF RFCs as its specification, but the evidence names no official Fastmail SDK. The jmap.io mention of a "Rust library" and "Typescript library" refers to the open JMAP protocol ecosystem and is not shown to be Fastmail-maintained. A documented raw API is a developer building block, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit here.
